messages:
sophie_cs: FYI escalating Aurora Labs — onboarding pipeline hit repeated model-timeouts in their sandbox, churn risk if not resolved before EOW. Please triage. @raj_support can you take first look? :alarm_clock:

raj_support: On it. Can you DM me their org id + example convo? have they hit 502 or timeouts? I see spikes in our traces earlier.

sophie_cs: Org: aurora-labs (org_9832). Sample from support ticket pasted below.

support ticket excerpt:
```
User: "generation failing after 25s, get 'context lost' error"
Req id: req_xYz123
Model: redwood-3.2-medium
Convo length: 1500 tokens
```

They reported delay since last week after switching to streaming=true.

raj_support: repro steps? if it's streaming + long convo we might be hitting kv cache eviction on gpu. I'll reproduce on staging with same model + length.

maria_se: Heads-up — Aurora is in renewal talks, next qtr billing review on 6/10. If we don't stabilize by EOB Fri, CS asks for credits/comp. Priority: P1 for CS.

dan_oncall: I can run live trace capture. @raj_support please add request ids and I'll pull the GPU logs. Also opening a dedicated support ticket: SUP-2026-1039

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-2026-1039 assigned to raj_support, severity P1. Link: https://redwood.support/t/SUP-2026-1039 :white_check_mark:

raj_support: reprod on staging — tail of kv cache shows evictions at step 600, model response pauses for ~18s then resumes. Suspect batching threshold + streaming flag causing repeat kv reload.

sophie_cs: Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate acknowledgement to customer with P1 SLA (by EOD today) 2) Daily updates at 10am PST until resolved 3) Offer one week credit if not resolved by Fri 4) Warm handoff to eng-ml for root cause. @james_csm can you approve scripted message?

james_csm: Approved. Use this message: "We're on it — assigned P1 to engineering, will update daily at 10am PST. We're prioritizing Aurora's requests and will follow up with mitigation steps." :thumbsup:

raj_support: Quick mitigation I can try now: disable streaming for their tenant as a toggle on dedicated config and set max_batch_tokens to 1024. If that reduces timeouts we buy time for a proper fix.

maria_se: Do it. Please confirm before changing prod behavior. If toggled, I'll notify Aurora this afternoon and note workaround.

dan_oncall: prepping rollback plan. Raj, ping when you've toggled and share the config diff. I'll tail infra for side-effects.

raj_support: Toggled streaming=false for org_9832 on prod at 1768890500, set max_batch_tokens=1024. Monitoring now — initial requests completed in 3s. Noticing slight CPU bump but within SLO.

sophie_cs: Sending update to Aurora now. Will share support ticket link + next steps. Thanks team — please keep thread updated with any regressions.

dan_oncall: Observability note — add a 24h dashboard for org_9832 latency and token churn. I'll create dash and share link.

raj_support: Recording findings for eng-ml handoff: likely kv cache eviction under streaming with large prefix. Attaching logs to SUP-2026-1039. Action items: eng-ml to investigate caching policy and fallback behavior.

support-bot: SUP-2026-1039 updated with logs and staging repro steps. Related PR/issue: ENG-INF-621

sophie_cs: Closing loop: we'll keep as P1 until eng-ml posts a patch or workaround. Next sync tomorrow 10am PST. Thanks all.
